# Enveda CASMI 2026 team solutions

> Kaggle code competition: rank up to 25 SMILES per unknown molecule from MS/MS spectra (MRR@25, InChIKey14). Offline notebook, 9 h, T4.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules and navigation for AI agents
- [INDEX.md](INDEX.md): every file with a one-line purpose (generated)

## Competition
- [docs/competition/overview.md](docs/competition/overview.md): task, metric, submission format, timeline
- [docs/competition/data.md](docs/competition/data.md): files, columns, source libraries, test novelty classes
- [docs/competition/rules-and-pitfalls.md](docs/competition/rules-and-pitfalls.md): allowed data and known traps

## Solutions
- [solutions/README.md](solutions/README.md): the list of solutions and their layout contract
- [solutions/fusion-v4n/AGENTS.md](solutions/fusion-v4n/AGENTS.md): public-0.399 reproduction with tunable fusion
